mapper.select: select #{end} time,proto_type type,max(link_num) linknum ,sum(c2s_pkt_num)+sum(s2c_pkt_num) pakeagenum, sum(c2s_byte_len)+sum(s2c_byte_len) bytes FROM traffic_protocol_statistic where stat_time between #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY proto_type

SELECT #{end} time ,ip_addr ip,area_id area,link_num links,c2s_pkt_num+s2c_pkt_num packets, c2s_byte_len+s2c_byte_len bytes FROM traffic_ip_active_statistic where stat_time between #{start} and #{end};

SELECT #{end} time,ip_addr ip,count(ip_addr) count,area_id area,max(link_num) links,sum(c2s_pkt_num)+sum(s2c_pkt_num) packets, sum(c2s_byte_len)+sum(s2c_byte_len) bytes FROM traffic_ip_active_statistic WHERE stat_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY ip_addr,area_id
